comparison.objective: Raise a gravity guard no more than 8 cm, feed a press blank to a backstop with a push stick, and lower the guard.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a guard against gravity while pushing a blank with a separate tool versus hold a mandrel coaxially while striking it, then retrieve fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Guard height limited, blank at backstop, stick removed, guard lowered without dropping; further numeric failure gates are absent. Candidate requires four safe fractures and full tang containment.
comparison.reason: The bimanual hold-and-tool pattern is generic; guarded feeding does not test controlled fracture or debris recovery.
